title: Limits of observability · ET-SoC-1 reports hub
description: The index of every ET-SoC-1 measurement report, with a map of the sessions behind them, and what can be observed on the card at every granularity: from board power a few times a second down to a flip-flop per cycle in the open RTL, which events the meter can see, where the unmetered watts go, and what would let us see more.
